subject: Order form: pricing schedule, invoice routing & min-commit clarifications
messages:
From: Claire Roberts <claire@arcadian.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@arcadian.io
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Order form questions — pricing cadence + invoicing routing

Hi Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks for sending the draft order form. Procurement reviewed it this morning and we have a couple of clarifying asks before we route to legal for countersignature: 

1) Invoice recipient / remit instructions — on page 2 the recipient is a Redwood US entity but our AR team requires the invoice to be issued to Arcadian Health (US) with a separate remit-to entity for tax purposes. Can Redwood provide the exact billing entity name we should expect on invoices and whether you support sending the invoice to our AP mailbox vs. the vendor portal?

2) Minimum commit cadence — the pricing schedule shows a quarterly min-commit. Our finance team prefers an annual commitment with quarterly invoicing. Will Redwood accept an annualized minimum committed spend and invoice quarterly? Any impact on tiered pricing?

3) Net terms & PO — are you able to accept Net45 and a PO reference on each invoice? Procurement will only sign after we confirm net terms and PO acceptance.

4) Tax evidence — please confirm whether Redwood can accept our VAT/residency certificate (attached) and whether withholding will be or will not be applied.

I've attached the current order form (Arcadian_OrderForm_v2.pdf) and our tax cert (Arcadian_Tax_Cert.pdf). Procurement is waiting on a short confirmation so we can finalize.

Appreciate your help,

— Claire
Claire Roberts
Head of Procurement, Arcadian Health
claire@arcadian.io
[Attachment: Arcadian_OrderForm_v2.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Arcadian_Tax_Cert.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Claire Roberts <claire@arcadian.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form questions — pricing cadence + invoicing routing

Claire — thanks, and great questions. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Ben (finance) to confirm the details below. High level answers up front: we can accept PO references, support quarterly invoicing on an annualized commitment, and we will confirm the exact invoicing entity and VAT flow after Ben reviews.

Quick proposed approach: 
- Billing entity: Ben will confirm the legal entity line that will appear on the invoice (likely Redwood Inference, Inc. — Ben, please confirm whether we can issue "Bill To: Arcadian Health" while remit-to remains Redwood Inference, Inc.).
- Commitment cadence: Redwood is comfortable contracting to an annual minimum commit with quarterly invoicing. Pricing tiers are based on annualized usage; we will not re-tier mid-year unless usage thresholds are met.
- Net terms: We can accept Net45 for this deal (pending finance approval). Ben?
- Taxes: Kimberly — can legal confirm if the standard order form language already covers withholding and whether we need to add a short clause referencing Arcadian's VAT certificate.

Action items: 
1) Ben — confirm invoice entity + whether we can set AP distribution to procurement@arcadian.io and include PO number on invoice line items.
2) Kimberly — apply a short carve-out to the tax section that references an attached tax certificate; advise if any additional evidence required.
3) Claire / Arcadian — confirm you will sign with a PO and if procurement needs the final doc in DocuSign.

I've attached an annotated copy with two minor editorial redlines (file coming from Kimberly). Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 415 555 0182

[Note: Attachment Redlines_annotated.docx to follow from legal]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Roberts <claire@arcadian.io>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form questions — pricing cadence + invoicing routing

Jonas / Ben / Claire — I reviewed Arcadian's draft and the questions Jonas summarized. Attached is Redlines_annotated.docx with tracked changes and short commentary. Key points: 

1) Invoice entity / remit: Redwood can issue invoices from Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity). We will include a "Bill To" field with Arcadian Health and can send copies to procurement@arcadian.io. If Arcadian requires the invoice to be legal-issued to a different Arcadian entity, we need a brief written confirmation from procurement to avoid tax residency mismatches.

2) Minimum commit + pricing tiers: We can convert to an annual minimum committed spend with quarterly invoices. Pricing tiers will be annualized and fixed for the first 12 months; language added to avoid mid-term re-tiering unless usage breaches tier thresholds by more than 15%.

3) Net terms: Proposed: Net45, subject to credit approval. Ben — please confirm credit OK. I added fallback language for Net30 if credit check fails, with a 14-day notice.

4) Taxes & withholding: I added a short paragraph accepting Arcadian's VAT certificate for residence evidence and confirming Redwood will not gross-up prices for withholding absent statutory necessity. We will need Arcadian's signed tax certificate and W-9 or equivalent for US tax withholding avoidance.

5) PO handling & invoice references: We will add a clause to include a "Customer PO#" on each invoice and accept POs as an explicit procurement condition. Please note: POs that materially change payment timing or introduce new payment conditions require pre-approval.

I've attached the redline and a one-page summary for Ben/Finance to confirm the invoice candidate lines (entity name, remit-to).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redlines_annotated.docx (DOCX)]

From: Claire Roberts <claire@arcadian.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, procurement@arcadian.io
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form questions — pricing cadence + invoicing routing

Thanks everyone — the redlines look reasonable. Procurement confirmed they will issue a PO referencing the final order form and can accept Net45. A couple of small asks before we execute: 

• Please add a single line to the invoice example showing where the PO number will appear (e.g., "PO#: 2028-ARC-4312").
• We will upload the signed tax cert in DocuSign alongside the order form. Can you send the final DocuSign packet (order form + the tax certificate acceptance clause) to procurement@arcadian.io?

If those two items are added we are ready to sign and I will route to our finance director for the PO. Thanks for the quick turnaround — Claire

— Claire Roberts
Head of Procurement, Arcadian Health
claire@arcadian.io
